records.requirement: Track long-term vision and strategic direction.
records.proof: The vision document, long-term goal registry, and structured goal records define the direction and keep it tied to evidence-backed goals.
gaps: Future strategy changes still need dated review records.
records.next_action: Keep vision changes tied to review logs, evidence records, and roadmap updates.

records.requirement: Track yearly, quarterly, monthly, and weekly planning horizons.
records.proof: Planning horizon records validate yearly, quarterly, monthly, and weekly lanes, and the monthly review checks long-term alignment.
gaps: Horizon records are static local records, not a live calendar or scheduling system.
records.next_action: Keep horizon records current during real review cadence updates.

records.requirement: Track active projects, milestones, and epics.
records.proof: Goal records include milestone and epic fields, the milestone map documents the hierarchy, and active project records link to horizons and goals.
gaps: Milestones are foundation records, not a fully interactive timeline.
records.next_action: Use the same milestone and epic ids when adding future routed Command Center views.

records.requirement: Track tasks and subtasks as separate execution records.
records.proof: The execution registry validates task ids, subtask ids, statuses, blockers, decisions, evidence references, and next actions.
gaps: This is a local fixture contract, not a task database.
records.next_action: Keep the task registry as the source for static views until a database or live adapter is designed.

records.requirement: Track blockers, risks, and their required next actions.
records.proof: Blocked goals and execution blockers expose repository hygiene, governance, and validation blockers with severity, evidence, and next action.
gaps: Repository hygiene blockers remain unresolved.
records.next_action: Resolve the tracked deletion set through a focused repository hygiene PR before readiness claims.

records.requirement: Track architecture and governance decisions that affect goal execution.
records.proof: The execution registry stores accepted decisions for non-LLM-first goals, deletion handling, read-only repository intelligence, and real review cadence.
gaps: Future high-impact decisions still need ADR-level documentation when they change architecture.
records.next_action: Promote durable architecture decisions into ADRs when implementation scope expands.

records.requirement: Track daily, weekly, and monthly reviews without faking performed reviews.
records.proof: Cadence records define daily, weekly, and monthly review rules, while performed review logs remain separate and evidence-backed.
gaps: Future periods still need current evidence before they can be marked performed.
records.next_action: Create new review log records only when the actual review is performed.

records.requirement: Track validation evidence, limitations, and failed or blocked checks.
records.proof: The evidence ledger records passed, failed, blocked, observed, and partial evidence with limitations and next actions.
gaps: No full secret-history, dependency, or public-readiness scan has been performed.
records.next_action: Keep validation scope explicit and run broader scans only when repository hygiene is isolated.

records.requirement: Track completed work, deferred work, and follow-up actions with evidence.
records.proof: The progress ledger validates completed, deferred, and follow-up items, and the completion gate prevents full-objective completion claims.
gaps: Completed items prove only their named scope.
records.next_action: Keep adding completed items only when evidence and limitations are recorded.

records.requirement: Expose next safe actions for goals, tasks, blockers, reviews, and follow-ups.
records.proof: The execution registry, generated view model, and progress ledger expose next-action fields throughout the Goal Tracking OS foundation.
gaps: Live queue assignment and notifications are not implemented.
records.next_action: Use the static next-action queue until a safe workflow queue is designed.

records.requirement: Distinguish active official goals from deferred, archived, deprecated, and historical material.
records.proof: Goal statuses include deferred, archived, and deprecated states, and the docs index separates active docs from historical evidence records.
gaps: No dedicated archived-goal ledger or archive review registry exists yet.
records.next_action: Add an archive review registry only after the active foundation remains stable.

records.requirement: Track all required strategic categories with status, evidence, blockers, and next action.
records.proof: The goal registry validates 20 required categories and the generated Command Center view exposes category status.
gaps: Several categories remain planned or blocked because implementation evidence is not present.
records.next_action: Keep planned and blocked categories visible until evidence changes.

records.requirement: Define and validate the lightweight goal object fields.
records.proof: The schema doc and validator enforce id, title, category, priority, status, owner role, target phase, dependencies, blockers, risks, evidence, validation, review cadence, and next action fields.
gaps: The object is a file-backed contract, not persistent application storage.
records.next_action: Keep the file-backed contract stable before adding storage adapters.

records.requirement: Expose a Goal Tracking Center with active goals, blockers, next actions, validation, readiness, and platform progress.
records.proof: The generated static Goal Tracking Center and Command Center shell expose the main foundation panels without LLM or external API dependency.
gaps: The app surface is static and not a routed runtime.
Live GitHub, release, public-readiness, and SSH integrations are not connected.
records.next_action: Keep static contracts stable before adding dynamic routing or live adapters.

records.requirement: Show milestone timeline, progress cards, blocker view, next safe action panel, evidence links, and readiness connections without fake progress bars.
records.proof: The static page renders progress cards, blockers, next actions, validation, planning, readiness, objective coverage, and completion gates without fake percentages.
gaps: Milestone timeline exists as planning and milestone fields, not a dedicated interactive timeline.
records.next_action: Add a dedicated timeline component only after the static contract remains validated.

records.requirement: Prevent fake progress, fake completion, fake validation, private data, unsupported claims, and private paths.
records.proof: Evidence records include limitations, completion gates keep partial requirements partial, and scoped sensitive-pattern checks passed for edited Goal Tracking files.
gaps: Scoped checks are not a full history or dependency security scan.
records.next_action: Run broader scans after repository hygiene recovery.

records.requirement: Keep goal tracking useful without an LLM connection.
records.proof: Structured records, validators, generators, and static pages run locally without model-provider state.
gaps: Future LLM assistance still needs evidence-aware routing and permission boundaries.
records.next_action: Keep LLM summaries optional and subordinate to structured records.

records.requirement: Connect goals to evidence, roadmap, backlog, next PR queue, schema, product docs, progress reviews, and Command Center.
records.proof: The foundation connects records to docs, roadmap, backlog, PR queue, generated view data, static Goal Tracking Center, and static Command Center shell.
gaps: Dynamic Command Center runtime and repository hygiene recovery remain unfinished.
records.next_action: Resolve repository hygiene blockers before promoting the static shell into a broader app runtime.

records.requirement: Connect repository intelligence, governance, public readiness, and release readiness blockers to Goal Tracking OS.
records.proof: Known repository hygiene, governance, public-readiness, and release-readiness blockers are visible in status, backlog, PR queue, and execution records.
gaps: No live repository intelligence scanner or GitHub PR integration has been connected.
records.next_action: Build read-only scanner outputs after the P0 deletion set is resolved or isolated.

records.requirement: Keep dangerous actions approval-gated and documented as deferred.
records.proof: Deferred items and the next PR queue list approval-needed work, including GitHub inspection, file deletion, deployment, SSH, releases, and live integrations.
gaps: Approval workflow UI is documented but not implemented as a live queue.
records.next_action: Keep approval-needed items visible until a formal approval center exists.

records.requirement: Track live GitHub PR, release, public-readiness, SSH, deployment, model-provider, benchmark, and dataset states only when verified.
records.proof: Current reports explicitly mark these states as unverified or deferred rather than inventing successful integrations.
gaps: No external GitHub, SSH, deployment, model-provider, benchmark, or dataset operation was performed.
records.next_action: Only promote live integration states after approved execution and recorded evidence.

records.requirement: Maintain an inspectable requirement-by-requirement matrix for the Goal Tracking OS objective.
records.proof: This matrix records requirement groups, status, evidence, gaps, and next action in a structured file and a review document.
gaps: The matrix reflects current local evidence and must be refreshed when source records change.
records.next_action: Regenerate the Goal Tracking Command Center view whenever requirement matrix records change.
